d:
In this video, we’ll create a free Databricks account and start with a hands-on demo using PySpark. You’ll learn how to explore the Databricks workspace, create notebooks, and perform basic read/write operations on data.
All code and data files are available on the below path:
What you’ll learn:
How to create a free Databricks account and log in
Overview of Databricks workspace and Unity Catalog
How to create your first notebook and write PySpark code
Reading tables using Spark (spark.read.table)
Displaying data using show() and display()
